Name: Bered, Son of Shuthelah
Summary: Son of Shuthelah and father of Tahath in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:20: Son of Shuthelah and father of Tahath in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Bered stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
